mission.purpose: MONTREAL.AI’s business-development lead has one 30-minute review window for Canadian public-sector opportunities. Help them decide which currently open opportunities for an applied AI team merit that time and which to pass over. The result should stay usable when notices change and should identify the decision deadline and next action for each opportunity worth reviewing.
requirements: Each opportunity recommended for review must be currently open, match the applied AI scope, and cite its closing deadline and official notice. Flag incomplete or stale evidence.
The decision process must apply to new public notices and amendments within a 30-minute operator review window.
